summary: A 236-unit affordable apartment complex (up to 60% AMI) at 420 Berry Street in Mission Bay North, next to Mission Creek Park, developed by Related Companies and Chinatown Community Development Center and designed by David Baker & Associates to follow the curve of the adjacent Caltrain tracks. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8703, lot 006) records the building's construction year as 2007.
